argument: The relation must live in record geometry: the source needs actual missing segments, the target needs an actual shifted break, and the corridor needs changed offsets. A highlight, line overlay, or counter cannot substitute for a re-set register.

With labels, readout, controls, captions, and furniture hidden, the first field should read as one printed register with interruptions and asymmetrical spacing, not a node lattice, loop procession, membrane, radial crown, or decorative bar grid. After a pair, the excision and reply must be findable in the bars themselves.
A first tap must remain memory-neutral. Only a second non-local witness seals the pair; same-place taps are refused; Delete restores the exact preceding register and R releases bounded memory.

The little-critters mechanism is translated from local attention and reciprocal looking into a two-place filing relation. No animal, eye, paper-scene, source palette, or head-turning surface vocabulary may carry the relation.

Delete v026 if the sheet is only a decorative bar grid, if source and target changes are cosmetic, if the corridor ignores the pair, if a first tap commits, if lifting is inexact, or if the caption is required to see that the crowd has become an archive of contested registration.
